text:
liz: Opening a PR to add a 'Graceful degradation' section to troubleshooting docs — examples for 429s, timeouts, and context-limit fallbacks + compact SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 :eyes:
sam: Nice. Can you include minimal SDK snippets for python + node showing: retry with backoff -> switch to smaller model -> failover to cached response?
liz: Yep. Plan: two snippets (python requests + node SDK), a short flowchart, and a 'circuit-breaker' recommendation box.
mike: Also add a short example explaining token trimming behavior for context-limit fallbacks — folks are confused about trimming from start vs end and preserving system prompts.
liz: Good call. I'll add a small code example and a before/after prompt showing preserving system messages.
ashley: Heads-up: migration guide has links to the old runbook at /docs/runtime/fallbacks — we need to update those to the new path when this lands. I'll sweep links in the PR checklist.
docs-ci: lint: broken link detected in docs/site/content/troubleshooting.md -> /docs/runtime/fallbacks (404).
liz: Thanks @docs-ci — I'll update all references to /docs/troubleshooting/graceful-degradation and run the link checker again before merging.
sam: For the 429 pattern can we include an operator-level ordered checklist: 1) detect 429 -> 2) retry with exponential backoff (cap) -> 3) try smaller model variant -> 4) if still failing, return cached/approximate answer or enqueue for async processing. A tiny curl + pseudo-code example would help.
liz: Yep — will add a compact flow + curl example. Example snippet I plan to include: ```bash
# simple retry + fallback pseudo
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -d '{"model":"rwd-large","prompt":"..."}' || curl -X POST -d '{"model":"rwd-small","prompt":"..."}'```
mike: One more ask: add an FAQ blurb clarifying SLA/fallback boundaries for Dedicated vs Hosted customers. People ask if fallback to hosted is allowed when on Dedicated pools.
liz: I'll add a short FAQ: Dedicated customers can opt-in to cross-tier fallbacks via their policy; default is no cross-tenant fallbacks. Link to ops policy and Dedicated config.
ashley: I can help convert the node snippet to the new SDK shape and add tests for the sample in examples/. Ping me in the PR review.
liz: Great — assigning you the node snippet. Plan to merge tomorrow after CI passes and a quick link sweep. cc @product
